import pytest

EXPECTED_SYMPTOM = {
    "exception_type": "TypeError",

def test_reproduce_issue():
    def gen():
        yield 'chunk1'
        yield 'chunk2'
    req = requests.Request('POST', 'http://httpbin.org/post', data=gen())
    p = req.prepare()
    assert p.body is not None
